'''Ground Base Seven''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] base established on [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was located near the [[Rotfurze Wastes]].
